Applies request-scoped external findings before output rendering

```zig title="Zig"

const xberg = @import("xberg");

    const result = try xberg.extract_with_external_redaction("{\"bytes\":[116,111,107,101,110,45,55,52,50,57,32,101,109,97,105,108,101,100,32,97,108,105,99,101,64,101,120,97,109,112,108,101,46,99,111,109,46],\"filename\":\"external-findings.txt\",\"kind\":\"bytes\",\"mime_type\":\"text/plain\"}", "{}", "[{\"label\":\"inspection_token\",\"score\":0.99,\"text\":\"token-7429\"}]", "unicode_code_points", 8);
    std.debug.print("{any}\n", .{ result.results[0].content });
}
```
